PRIMARY_RECOMMENDATION.reason: Permissive academic and commercial reuse with an explicit patent grant and termination mechanism, while keeping the externally invoked GPL/LGPL backends outside project artifacts.

SECONDARY_OPTION.reason: Simple permissive terms and a non-endorsement clause suit university dissemination, but patent rights are less explicit.

NOT_RECOMMENDED_FOR_CURRENT_GOAL.reason: Strong copyleft adds avoidable integration and technology-transfer review for the stated enterprise-collaboration goal.
